Voidknight.name: Shadow Ascendant
Voidknight.description: +15% damage, -10% block chance, -35% threat generation. DPS or solo play; not recommended for group tanking.

Voidknight.name: Necrotic Bastion
Voidknight.description: +15% block chance, -10% damage, +25% Life Drain healing. Offsets the damage loss with life steal and maintains threat through healing — ideal for group tanking.

Voidknight.name: Dusk Walker
Voidknight.description: +7% damage, +7% block chance. Flexible for mixed scenarios, solo or group content.

Shadowblade.name: Stealth
Shadowblade.description: Move unseen. Satisfies Backstab's "from stealth" requirement regardless of facing. Toggle off (or the stance bar again) to come out of hiding.

_comment: class_stances.json - each class's stances (stance_bar.gd shows them; one at a time, applied as a permanent effect). Per stance: stance_id, name, description, icon, modifiers (combat modifiers while it's up). Optional (Aetherfist): level (unlocks at), procs (auto-attack hits only: stun {chance,min,max} seconds, lifesteal {chance,pct}, burn {chance,dps,seconds,stacks}, void {chance}), boosts (ability ids that are 25% stronger in this stance), group (modifiers given to group members within 10 m; the same element from two monks doesn't stack), aura ([r,g,b] colour of the glow and particles everyone sees).

Aetherfist.name: Wind Stance
Aetherfist.description: Gale Step: +8 dodge, +10% movement and attack speed, -5% damage. Hits have a 5% chance to stun for 3-5 seconds. Swift Step and Flying Kick are stronger. Group: +5% movement speed.

Aetherfist.name: Earth Stance
Aetherfist.description: Stone Root (backup tank): take 20% less damage, +50% threat, +5 parry; -15% damage and -10% attack speed. Earth Strike and Mountain's Challenge are stronger. Group: take 3% less damage.

Aetherfist.name: Water Stance
Aetherfist.description: Flowing Tide: +8 parry, +3 health regen, -5% damage. Hits have a 15% chance to heal you for 30% of the damage. Water Strike and Mend Wounds are stronger. Group: +1 health regen.

Aetherfist.name: Fire Stance
Aetherfist.description: Ember Fist: +12% damage, -5 dodge and parry. Hits have a 20% chance to set the target burning (3 damage a second for 4 seconds, stacks 3 times). Fire Strike is stronger. Group: +3% damage.

Aetherfist.name: Void Stance
Aetherfist.description: Hollow Palm: +5% damage, take 10% more damage. Hits have a 15% chance to add a random effect: weaken, blind, silence, drain mana, or stun for 3-5 seconds. Ki Strike is stronger. Group: +5 magic resistance.
